title: Check a username
description:
Write `isValidUsername(name)` using one regular expression. A valid username:

- is 3 to 16 characters long,
- uses only letters `a`–`z` (either case), digits and `_`,
- starts with a letter.

```javascript
isValidUsername("ada_99");   // true
isValidUsername("9lives");   // false: starts with a digit
isValidUsername("al");       // false: too short
```
hints: Anchor both ends with `^` and `$`, or the pattern will happily match part of a longer, invalid name.
One letter, then 2 to 15 more allowed characters: `[a-z]` followed by `[a-z0-9_]{2,15}`. The `i` flag lets `[a-z]` match capitals too.
